title: Watch Metric2 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:metric2
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for watch metric2 (2).
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag watch metric2 (2) events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates whether your watch metric2 (2) activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
